headline: Proposed Colombian Rescue Law Aims to Raise VAT on Food and Inputs to 19%
summary: A proposed tax reform in Colombia would eliminate reduced VAT rates for food, agricultural inputs, and medicine starting in 2028, moving them to a 19% rate.
why: Value-added tax adjustments on essential goods and agricultural inputs alter consumer purchasing power, household cost of living, and sector-specific retail demand.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Broad VAT hikes on consumer goods influence inflation expectations and retail sector spending.
